Message.Name: Modify Order Message
Message.Description: The Modify Order message is generated when an existing order identified by the OrderId is modified. The only attribute that can be modified is the quantity. Note for Securities instruments the OrderBookPosition is always set to zero.

Field.Name: SecurityCode
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies a security available for trading.

Field.Name: OrderId
Field.Description: Unique identifier for each order performed within the trading day.

Field.Name: OrderBookPosition
Field.Description: Order rank information for the order position within the order book for each security.
